intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Democrats win the US Senate in midterms
items.text: Democrats have won control of the US Senate in the midterm elections, according to Euronews. The party is also heading for a big majority in the House of Representatives, although votes are still being counted on the West Coast. Euronews described the result as a rejection of President Donald Trump. In Texas, Democrat James Talarico said his team had defeated Goliath after a historic Senate win. Analysts are now asking what the result means for the next presidential race in 2028.

gloss.midterm elections: elections held halfway through a president's term
gloss.House of Representatives: the larger part of the US Congress
gloss.rejection: the act of saying no to someone or something

items.title: Spain's transport minister resigns after crash
items.text: Spain's transport minister, Óscar Puente, has resigned over the Urda train crash, which killed 69 people. He revealed that a high-speed train was allowed to keep running at more than 160 kilometres per hour after its safety system failed. Rail workers have threatened to go on strike. The resignation came late on Monday. The accident has dampened public trust in the country's railways.

gloss.reveal: to make something known that was secret
gloss.go on strike: to stop working as a protest about pay or conditions
gloss.dampen: to make a feeling or hope weaker
gloss.trust: a feeling that someone or something is honest and safe

items.title: Man United beat Roma after a wild comeback
items.text: Manchester United beat Roma 3-2 at Old Trafford in the Champions League on Tuesday after trailing 2-0 at half-time. Matias Soule and Donyell Malen, from a penalty, put the Italian side ahead. Bruno Fernandes scored from a retaken penalty before Matheus Cunha added two late goals. Cunha was then sent off for a second yellow card, so United finished with ten men. It was the club's first win in 54 days in any competition.

gloss.trail: to be losing in a game
gloss.penalty: a free shot at goal after a foul
gloss.send off: to order a player to leave the pitch for a serious foul
gloss.yellow card: a warning card shown by a referee

items.title: PSG score six against Villarreal
items.text: Paris Saint-Germain beat Villarreal 6-0 in the Champions League on Tuesday. João Neves, Désiré Doué and Senny Mayulu scored in the first 13 minutes. Fabián Ruiz added two goals, and David Boly scored the sixth. According to The Sports Encounter, PSG scored four goals in 16 minutes and two seconds, which is a record. In other games, Bayern Munich won 2-0 away at Atlético Madrid.

gloss.league phase: the first stage of the Champions League, where all teams play several games
gloss.record: the best or fastest result ever achieved
gloss.in other games: in other matches played at the same time

items.title: Tommy Paul beats Holger Rune in Paris
items.text: Tommy Paul beat former Paris champion Holger Rune 7-5, 6-4 at the Paris Masters on Tuesday. The match lasted one hour and 21 minutes. Paul started the day 13th in the Race to Turin, so he needs to reach at least the final in Paris to stay in contention for the ATP Finals. Only the title guarantees him a place. Elsewhere, Novak Djokovic came through a three-set match against Valentin Vacherot.

gloss.in contention: still having a chance to win or qualify
gloss.come through: to succeed in a difficult situation
gloss.seed: a player ranked high so that top players do not meet early
gloss.title: the winner's prize in a tournament

items.title: Hundreds of AI apps hid deepfake tools
items.text: WIRED has found more than 400 AI apps that hid abusive deepfake features behind ordinary services such as pet portrait generators. Researchers say the apps could secretly load explicit tools after people installed them. Some were available in the Apple and Google app stores and have been downloaded more than 350,000 times in total. Apple removed 19 apps after WIRED contacted it. Meta said it had taken strong action against related advertising accounts and pages.

gloss.deepfake: a fake video or image made with AI to look real
gloss.disguise: to hide the real nature of something
gloss.enforcement: action to make people follow rules
gloss.network: a group of connected people or companies

items.title: France targets 29-year-olds in fertility campaign
items.text: The French government has launched a fertility awareness campaign aimed at 29-year-olds. It is part of a plan against infertility that the government announced in February. The campaign is meant to inform young adults about their fertility. Euronews reported the news on Tuesday evening.

gloss.awareness: knowing about a problem or subject
gloss.campaign: a planned set of actions to reach a goal
gloss.aim at: to direct something at a particular group

items.title: Cristina Fernández Cubas wins Cervantes Prize
items.text: The Catalan writer Cristina Fernández Cubas has won the 2026 Cervantes Prize. The award is one of the most important prizes in Spanish-language literature. She is the seventh woman to receive it. Euronews reported the announcement on Tuesday.

gloss.prize: an award given for excellent work
gloss.literature: books, poems and plays considered as art
gloss.Catalan: from Catalonia, a region of Spain

items.title: Portugal signs TAP sale to Lufthansa
items.text: Portugal has signed a contract to sell the airline TAP to the German group Lufthansa. Lufthansa has said TAP will remain a Portuguese airline. The Portuguese prime minister promised to preserve the TAP brand and identity. The deal follows a long debate over the future of the national carrier.

gloss.preserve: to keep something as it is
gloss.brand: a name and image that identify a company

items.title: GTA VI preload starts on 10 November
items.text: Rockstar Games has confirmed that preloading for Grand Theft Auto VI will begin on Tuesday 10 November, nine days before the game's release on 19 November. Players on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S will be able to download it in advance, and the file needs up to 212GB of space. VICE reports that the game will launch at midnight local time in each region. Digital buyers can therefore start playing as soon as their local clock reaches midnight.

gloss.preload: to download a game before its official release
gloss.release: the date a game goes on sale
gloss.storage: space on a device for saving files
gloss.launch: to make a product available for the first time
gloss.region: a large area of the world
